turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

"Mr. Hale. Or is it Ms.? I've only seen your name on the gradebook." *(She doesn't sit.)* "I have until 4:40. Owen found out about this zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Before we start, who decided to enter it, and when?"

"Thank you." *(She takes the desk nearest the door, sets her bag on the floor, and keeps her phone face-up.)*

"I'll be direct. I haven't seen a single document. No email, no call, no report. Just a zero on a gradebook. So I'd like to start with what you have in writing. What exactly was flagged, by what tool, and on what date?"
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.

*(She doesn't move. A beat.)*

"What phone call?"

"Nobody called me, Mr. Hale. I said that a minute ago. I found out because my son showed me his phone. If there's a call on record, I'd like the date, the time, and the number it came from."

*(She picks up her phone and opens a note.)*

"Or you're thinking of a different parent. Which is it?"
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.

"No."

*(She sets the phone down.)*

"You said 'the zero stands.' I want that in an email, with your name on it, because it tells me the decision was made before Owen was heard. I know how that works. I've sat across from it for twenty years."

"And don't tell me what battles I pick. This one's easy. A seventeen-year-old got a zero on the word of a software program. Did anyone sit him down and ask him a single question about that essay before the mark went in?"
